messages:
Maria Chen: Created RC build 2026.03.16-rc and pinned artifact sha abc123def. Release notes: https://redwood.internal/releases/2026.03.16-rc. Change window 22:00-02:00 UTC. Requesting product + SRE signoff for canary + promo.
Jamal Patel: LGTM from product side — acceptance tests passed against the rc branch. No product blockers.
Olivia Park: Quick Q — any DB migrations or schema changes in this RC?
Maria Chen: No DB migrations. Only a perf path behind feature flag `fast-path`. We'll keep the flag OFF during canary.
Kevin Li: SRE checklist: verify health checks, dashboards (latency, error-rate), and pre-set alert thresholds. Recommend canary steps: 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 30m holds between ramps.
sre-oncall: I'll be watching. Rollback criteria: 5xx > 1% sustained or p99 increase > 200ms. Will escalate if thresholds breach.
deploy-bot: Scheduled canary for RC abc123def at 2026-03-17T22:15:00Z. Playbook: 1) route 5% traffic to rc, wait 15m, run smoke; 2) if OK -> 25% wait 20m; 3) if OK -> 100% -> mark promoted. Rollback command available: `rbxctl rollback --env=prod --to-sha=prev-sha-987654`.
Maria Chen: I've added the rollback command to the release notes and pinned the runbook. Also adding short rollback steps in #incidents runbook.
Jamal Patel: Approving promo contingent on SRE thumbs at 25%. @sre-oncall please give final go/no-go at 25%.
sre-oncall: on it. I'll watch the dashboards and run the synthetic checks.
deploy-bot: Canary started: routing 5% of traffic to abc123def. Monitoring for 15m...
deploy-bot: Canary 5% complete — summary: errors 0.2%, p99 latency +10ms, no alert triggers.
sre-oncall: 5% looks good. Proceed to 25%.
deploy-bot: Ramped to 25% -> monitoring 20m...
deploy-bot: 25% check: errors 0.9%, p99 +30ms, no alerts fired.
Maria Chen: Good. Proceeding to full ramp. Keeping `fast-path` flag OFF until we validate perf post-100%.
Jamal Patel: Hold 10m after 100% ramp for final smoke, watching error budget.
Olivia Park: Note to docs team — hold on enabling `fast-path`. We'll flip after post-deploy perf check.
deploy-bot: Ramped to 100% -> post-deploy smoke passed. Promotion complete. Release marked as promoted in the changelog. :tada:
Maria Chen: Thanks team — saved the logs link and will do a 1h/4h health check cadence. Will open a short post-deploy note with metrics in ~1h.
Jamal Patel: Nice work, team.
sre-oncall: All quiet on my side so far. Will keep monitoring and report if anything pops up.
